decision.summary: A coherent multi-axis offset initiates near index 482 (N↑, E↓, U↓) with sustained deviation in N through 530 and only partial recovery in E/U. The return phase is unobserved or ambiguous within allowed context [445,570]; thus the interval is classified as uncertain. No other temporary offsets are confirmed in this region.

intervals.observation: N: sharp upward step ~482, sustained high level through 530; E: concurrent downward step ~482, partial recovery begins ~510 but not back to pre-event level by 530; U: drop ~482, gradual recovery but still below pre-event level at 530. Return not observed on E/U within allowed context; N shows no return. Cross-axis coherence supports single multi-component offset, but return is incomplete/ambiguous.
